# Amber Laurel (Lavender Crystal Pony)

Amber Laurel is a Crystal Empire earth pony mare from *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic* (G4). Think of her as one of Spike's enthusiastic admirers who becomes comically suspicious of him when changeling rumors sweep the Empire.

[![Amber Laurel — fan vector by starryshineviolet](https://derpicdn.net/img/2022/12/8/3003141/large.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/2847857)

- **Appearance:** Pale lavender coat, elaborate coral-red and peach curls piled into a high bun, curled tail, pink-purple crystal eyes, and a golden-orange ornamental flowerpot cutie mark.
- **Names and voice:** Amber Laurel is an unofficial fandom placeholder; the [Crystal Pony character directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies) identifies her licensed Gameloft game name as Lavender Crystal Pony. The original fan naming event is unverified. The directory attributes her speaking roles in S6E1 and S6E16 to Andrea Libman.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1), attends Flurry Heart's Crystalling in Part 2 (S6E2), and returns in *The Times They Are a Changeling* (S6E16). Further appearances are cataloged in *A Royal Problem*, *Uncommon Bond*, *The Parent Map*, and *The Beginning of the End – Part 1*. Gameloft also includes her in its [Crystal Empire quests](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Crystal_Empire_quests).

## Important moments

- **Remembering Spike's heroism** — *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1). She reminds the crowd that Spike also saved them during the Equestria Games, reinforcing his celebrity status in the Empire. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Crystalling_-_Part_1); [full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jhGRiw2kYkc), timestamp unavailable.
- **Is that really Spike?** — *The Times They Are a Changeling* (S6E16). She questions whether their beloved hero is actually a changeling, prompting Scarlet Heart to tell everyone to flee and illustrating the fear that Spike must overcome to help Thorax. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Times_They_Are_A_Changeling); [full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KmqsYfaBNGM), timestamp unavailable.
